title: Coinminer Incident Response
description: Investigate and respond to a coinminer infection on Linux servers.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The organization has detected unusual CPU usage on several Linux servers. Initial investigation suggests a possible coinminer infection. Your task is to investigate, analyze, and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
Access the sandbox via the provided cloud link. Use the following credentials:

Host: `miner-host`
Username: `cyrano`
Password: `cyrano`

Access method: SSH
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify the suspicious service
levels.content: Investigate the `miner-host` to identify the suspicious service responsible for the high CPU usage.
levels.solution: Check running services and their resource usage. The suspicious service is named `sys-monitor`.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Check running services and their resource usage.

levels.title: Identify the malware dropper artifact
levels.content: Locate the file used by the attacker to drop the malware on the `miner-host`.
levels.solution: Check the `/tmp` directory for suspicious files. The dropper artifact is located at `/tmp/ofd`.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Check the `/tmp` directory for suspicious files.

levels.title: Identify the persistence mechanism
levels.content: Investigate the persistence mechanism used by the malware on the `miner-host`.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services. The persistence mechanism is the `sys-monitor.service`.
